description: Visual equivalence of the layered render against the Remotion render of the same video. SSIM in RGB, each video decoded by its own color tags, frame by frame.

steps.fix: libplacebo blends in linear light, Chrome in gamma space: tag inputs and output as linear so values are not converted, then retag BT.709
choose the source frame with fps=30:round=up before libplacebo (25 to 30 fps)
